name: TC-AN-QB-007 — 批量填写：空输入 [P2]
description: 审核节点编辑页已打开
module: 审核管理/审核节点管理/参与人快捷按钮

steps.expression: (() => { const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-table-row'); if (rows.length > 0) { const editBtn = rows[0].querySelector('a[href*=edit], button'); if (editBtn) { editBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; } } return { clicked: false }; })()

(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')); const batchBtn = btns.find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('批量填写')); if (!batchBtn) return { clicked: false }; batchBtn.click(); return { clicked: true }; })()

(() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const confirmBtn = modal ? Array.from(modal.querySelectorAll('button')).find(b => (b.textContent || '').includes('确认')) : null; if (confirmBtn) { confirmBtn.click(); return { clicked: true, note: '输入框为空直接点确认' }; } return { clicked: false }; })()
steps.description: 输入框为空，直接点击确认导入

steps.expression: (() => { const modal = document.querySelector('.ant-modal, .ant-drawer'); const modalStillOpen = !!modal && modal.offsetParent !== null; const toasts = document.querySelectorAll('.ant-message-notice'); const toastTexts = Array.from(toasts).map(t => t.textContent.trim()); return { modalStillOpen, toastTexts }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 审核节点编辑页已打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1. 点击「批量填写」\n2. 不输入任何内容\n3. 点击确认导入
_testDesign.expectedResult: 弹窗保持打开，提示输入不能为空
